_comment: Steam lens (cursor weapon). Manual: follows the cursor. Auto (no cursor, or cursor still > idle_to_auto s): every auto_retarget s finds the x-band (auto_band px wide) with most enemies and sweeps up and down over it at auto_mult damage. With lens_seek (Наводчик) it glides straight to the densest group. Empty field: oval auto_path. Damage per tick = dmg + dmg_pct_hp * enemy max HP (bosses: * boss_pct_mult), so the lens stays useful against tough enemies.
